policy: Only exact active-surface references to mechanically superseded _vN tools may be exempted, and every exemption requires a non-empty reason. Version suffix ordering is navigation evidence, not proof of drop-in semantic compatibility.

entries.reason: Workflow is explicitly the V3 validation lane and intentionally pins the V3 subject; existence of V4 does not make this historical regression lane safe to auto-migrate.
Self-hosted reconciliation workflow intentionally observes v1, v3 and v4 attribution subjects together for cross-version/runtime lineage; v1 is a named evidence subject.
Self-hosted reconciliation workflow explicitly tests v3 and v4 lineage together; v3 remains a named compatibility/evidence subject, not an accidental current-tool pointer.
Shutdown/activation safety code enumerates legacy process entrypoints so older live processes are detected and terminated; removing v3 would weaken quiescence coverage.
v2 is implemented as a refinement over a v1 receipt and deliberately invokes v1 to preserve the prior observation contract.
v3 deliberately obtains the v1 probe receipt as its lower-level observation substrate; this is explicit version layering.
v4 still uses the v1 probe as the raw process-observation substrate before applying stronger attribution checks.
v4 imports v3 helper semantics as its immediate predecessor layer; replacing the import with v4 would be recursive and incorrect.
The enforcer's declared contract delegates bounded post-stop proof to the v1 probe; this is a pinned protocol dependency, not a generic latest-version lookup.
Fail-closed quiescence enforcement must recognize legacy v3 process roots in addition to newer entrypoints; this reference is part of the kill-scope safety inventory.
v2 loads v1 as its inner baseline probe and adds stronger sync/window checks around it; intentional predecessor composition.

This controller pins the established v3 economic-gate contract. Version number alone is insufficient evidence that v5 is interface/semantics compatible, so migration must be a separate validated change.
The split auditor documents and audits candidate rows produced by the v1 generator; it is an exact source/data-contract binding and must not silently retarget.
The origin gate explicitly audits the v1 pilot contract and is expected to block until that exact subject exposes the required envelope; successor substitution would change the experiment.
v2 declares itself a source-only successor to v1 and references v1 for lineage/documentation; no execution dispatch to v1 is inferred from the textual reference.
Atomic-cohort acceptance reuses the v2 physical GRID10 probe as a pinned source-script subject; v3 is a different later acceptance subject and is not assumed drop-in.
Derivation-bound gate hashes and binds the exact v1 labeler as evidence lineage; changing to v3 would invalidate the recorded derivation contract.
Semantic-hyperposition gate v2 composes the v1 base candidate gate as an explicit lower-layer contract; higher version is not automatically semantically equivalent.
Semantic-hyperposition gate v3 still intentionally composes the v1 base candidate gate while upgrading its labeler path; this is explicit mixed-version architecture.
Native seed generator binds the v2 semantic gate that defines its seed contract; retargeting to v3 would alter generated-data semantics and needs separate validation.
Same-cohort binding test uses the v2 acceptance script as its exact concurrent-probe subject; later v3 does not automatically supersede this experimental binding.
Writer-free supplemental harness explicitly closes an evidence gap in v2 and therefore must bind v2, not whichever later acceptance version has the highest suffix.
